subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay media from unmentioned group messages for later mentioned turns, and what bounded retention/visibility policy should govern it?
rationale: The code path is clear, but preserving unmentioned group attachments changes what later prompts can see and needs maintainer intent on privacy, retention, allowed media kinds, and sender/context-visibility rules.

options.title: Approve Bounded Retention
options.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages and expose it to later turns under existing group authorization and context-visibility rules.

options.title: Keep Text-Only History
options.body: Document that unmentioned Telegram media is not replayed from group history unless the current turn includes the attachment, avoiding new media-retention exposure.

options.title: Require Live Design Proof First
options.body: Keep the issue open until a Telegram live proof demonstrates the failure and proposed retention behavior before approving implementation.

recommendation.title: Approve Bounded Retention
recommendation.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages and expose it to later turns under existing group authorization and context-visibility rules.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Telegram group-history and canonical group-history changes make this the closest owner signal for the policy and implementation boundary.
